description: An HTML file that includes a script defining a Calculator class extending Service, which registers methods for addition and subtraction, and initializes a service manager to connect to a server and register the Calculator service.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class extending Service that provides add and sub methods for remote invocation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of parameters and returns a Promise resolving to the result.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two parameters and returns a Promise resolving to the result.
